title: Add additional permission check in asset materialization

target.summary: `DagDetails` is constructed without `team_name` when checking DAG authorization in `materialize_asset`. When using a team-aware auth manager, authorization for team-scoped DAGs evaluates against global DAG permissions instead of team-scoped permissions, improperly denying authorized team members.
notes: DagDetails constructed without team_name in the DAG authorization check
